scope: Fixed-Evidence replay pilot; real provider, production Python runtime and isolated PG. No ingestion, dense retrieval, Java auth or browser acceptance.
assessment: Source-based Codex AI review, not blind and not a human gold standard. Runtime model review is not used as semantic scoring.

independent_candidate_review.basis: Source-based Codex AI review, not blind or human gold. Format correction is not semantic revision.

limitations: Same previously seen six development tasks; no new held-out evaluation.
Fixed public Evidence, not ingestion/retrieval/Java/browser end-to-end.
Remote model aliases and hardware are not immutable verified identities.
All initial failures retained, including repaired attempts. No raw model response recorded for these failures.
Single sequential cohort per code snapshot; latency is diagnostic, not a controlled performance comparison.
